description: Land Acquisition - Land Acquisition under Section 07 of the Land Acquisition Act Divisional Secretariat Medadumbera
categorisation: The gazette content is a formal declaration under the Land Acquisition Act for the acquisition of a specific plot of land for a public purpose. It details the land's location, boundaries, and extent. While it is issued by a named Minister, the core subject matter is exclusively land acquisition—a property-related administrative action. According to the priority rules, specialized categories (4-9) are for non-governmental administrative matters, and this content fits the definition of a Land Gazette (Type 4).
